baseName.value: Balcony doors and entrance doors outward / inward opened 65 mm sash (BYKO – D65)

generalComment.value: “Balcony door and entrance door, outward / inward opened, 65 mm sash” (BYKO-D65) is double-glazed and has a thermal transmittance of 1,4 W/(m2*K). The dimensions (height x width) are made according to the customer's requirements. The calculation based on the assumption of The LCA results are scalable for the desired door dimension. The product is manufactured in Valmiera, Latvia, and marketed internationally. Kiwa-Ecobility Experts assumes no liability for manufacturer's information, LCA data and evidence.

description.value: All installed raw materials of the products were analysed and the masses were determined. Production-specific energy consumption were measured and provided by Bitus Latvia SIA. Supplier Information regarding the transport distances were provided by Bitus Latvia SIA. The production waste wood, metal and paint and other mixed production waste are collected separately. For plastics and steel, 100 per cent recycling is assumed, and for general production waste, 100 per cent landfilling is assumed, as waste incineration is not widespread in Latvia. Wood waste is thermally recovered at the site. For production waste that cannot be clearly allocated (seals, glass), a raw material-related production reject of 5 percent was calculated. As the product is marketed internationally, no country-specific waste scenario can be considered. Therefore, the waste scenario of PCR B (Appendix B.3) was adopted. Removing the door or window does not result in any environmental impacts, so the value for module C1 is assumed to be zero.

descriptionOfRestrictions.value: Geographical reference space of the background data is Latvia.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: All hardware is screwed in the sashes and frames. Doors can be side opened. The dimensions (height x width) are adapted according to customer requirements. The production phase (A3) consider the following processes: cutting of wood, preplanning, moulding and tapening, chiseling, wood frame impregnation, assembly of wood components, painting, assembly of glass and hardwere, packaging.

technologicalApplicability.value: The intended uses are in domestic and commercial locations.

useAdviceForDataSet.value: The intended uses are in domestic and commercial locations
